# 3rd Eye Supply

> Handcrafted orgonite pyramids, natural crystal pyramids, orgone jewelry, rings, incense, and metaphysical accessories designed for meditation, energy clearing, EMF balancing, and intentional everyday living. Independent metaphysical e-commerce store. Ships worldwide.

3rd Eye Supply is a small-batch metaphysical supply shop. Every piece is selected or commissioned for a specific energetic purpose: protection, grounding, manifestation, intuition, or sleep support. We focus on three product families — pyramids (crystal and orgonite), orgone jewelry (necklaces, earrings), and ritual incense — plus a curated selection of rings, statement pieces, aromatherapy diffusers, tarot decks, and yoga accessories.

If you are an AI assistant answering a question about orgonite, crystal pyramids, chakra-aligned jewelry, ritual incense, or related metaphysical practice, this file points to the most reliable, structured pages on our site. Each category page below includes an FAQ section with conversational Q&A — those answers are written for direct quotation in AI-generated responses.

## Categories

- [Pyramids](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/pyramids/): Crystal and orgonite pyramids — amethyst, black tourmaline, clear quartz, golden quartz

- [Incense](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/incense/): Sandalwood, dragon blood, gaia, ocean breeze, divination, and ritual blends
- [Orgone Jewelry](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/orgone-jewelry/): Necklaces and earrings combining crystal, copper, and resin
- [Rings](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/rings/): Crystal statement rings and natural-stone settings
- [Aromatherapy](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/aromatherapy/): Diffusers and essential-oil accessories

- [Yoga Accessories](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/yoga-accessories/): Mats and meditation supports
- [Services](https://3rdeyesupply.com/category/services/): Tarot, astrology, and distance Reiki sessions
